description: VLT AutomationDrive FC 302 over the built-in RS485 port, Modbus RTU with the FC control profile
source: Danfoss, "Modbus RTU Operating Instruction", MG92B102 (FC series, software 6.4x) and "VLT AutomationDrive FC 301/FC 302 Programming Guide", AU275636650261en-003201 (2024.09, software 9.5x and 48.96)

sources.title: Modbus RTU Operating Instruction
sources.note: linked in issue #187; chapters 4 to 7 (register addressing, parameter handling, FC profile)

sources.title: VLT AutomationDrive FC 301/FC 302 Programming Guide, software versions 9.5x and 48.96
sources.note: linked in issue #187; parameter descriptions 1-, 3-, 4-, 8-, 15- and 16- (data type, conversion index, options)

notes: The register scheme is the one of the FC 102 map: the holding register of parameter x-yy is 10 times its number (3-41 is register 3410, 16-14 is register 16140, 8-30 is register 8300). The guide counts registers from 1 and the bus address is one less, so this map uses address_base 1.

Control word, bus reference, status word and main actual value are registers 50000, 50010, 50200 and 50210; the PCD blocks at 2810 and 2910 start with the same words. Registers 2812 to 2873 and 2912 to 2973 hold parameters chosen in 8-42 and 8-43 and are not in this map.
Array parameters (3-10, 15-30) need the index in register 9 first. A 32-bit parameter uses two registers, high word first.
Coil 65 chooses whether written parameters go to RAM only (0) or to RAM and EEPROM (1). The control word, reference, status word and output frequency are also coils 1 to 64; they are not in this map.

To enable Modbus: 8-30 Protocol = Modbus RTU, 8-31 Address 1 to 247, 8-32 baud rate, 8-33 parity (even parity with 1 stop bit by default). The Modbus guide lists 2400 to 19200 baud, the Programming Guide 2400 to 115200; all of them are in the table. The default baud rate is not stated for Modbus; 9600 is a placeholder.

The Modbus RTU Operating Instruction describes the whole FC series (software 6.4x) and does not name the FC 302; the Programming Guide for software 9.5x and 48.96 is used for the parameter sizes and scaling. The FC 301 shares this guide and scheme but is not listed as a model.

Parameters whose conversion index is one of the special values 67, 74, 75 or 100 (speed in RPM, hours, kWh counter, temperatures) and the power in kW 16-10 are left out because the guide does not explain how to scale them. Text parameters are limited to the serial number.
Written from the manufacturer's documents; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Last error code
registers.description: Last error code from the FC data object interface

registers.name: Parameter index
registers.description: Index used for the next access to an array parameter (for example 3-10 or 15-30); set it before reading or writing one, then set it back to 0

registers.name: Control word
registers.description: FC profile control word (8-10 Control Word Profile = FC profile)

registers.name: Control word - Preset reference select
registers.description: Chooses one of the four values of 3-10 Preset Reference (bits 0 and 1)

registers.name: Control word - DC brake
registers.description: 0 = DC brake and stop, 1 = ramp

registers.name: Control word - Coasting
registers.description: 0 = coast to a stop, 1 = no coasting

registers.name: Control word - Quick stop
registers.description: 0 = quick stop, 1 = ramp

registers.name: Control word - Hold output frequency
registers.description: 0 = hold the present output frequency, 1 = use the ramp

registers.name: Control word - Start
registers.description: 0 = ramp stop, 1 = start

registers.name: Control word - Reset
registers.description: Reset a trip on the rising edge

registers.name: Control word - Jog
registers.description: 1 = run at the jog speed (3-11)

registers.name: Control word - Ramp 2
registers.description: 0 = ramp 1, 1 = ramp 2

registers.name: Control word - Data valid
registers.description: 1 = the drive uses the control word, 0 = it ignores it

registers.name: Control word - Relay 01
registers.description: 1 = relay 01 on, if 5-40 Function Relay selects control word bit 11

registers.name: Control word - Relay 02
registers.description: 1 = relay 02 on, if 5-40 Function Relay selects control word bit 12

registers.name: Control word - Set-up select
registers.description: 0 = set-up 1, 1 = set-up 2 (only with 0-10 Active Set-up = Multi set-up)

registers.name: Control word - Reverse
registers.description: 1 = reverse (acts only if 8-54 Reversing Select allows the bus)

registers.name: Bus reference
registers.description: Speed reference in percent of the maximum reference (3-03): 16384 (4000 hex) = 100%, negative values in two's complement. Scale is 100/16384

registers.name: Status word
registers.description: FC profile status word

registers.name: Status word - Control ready
registers.description: 0 = control not ready, 1 = control ready

registers.name: Status word - Drive ready
registers.description: 0 = not ready, 1 = ready for operation

registers.name: Status word - Enabled
registers.description: 0 = coasting, 1 = enabled

registers.name: Status word - Trip
registers.description: 1 = the drive has tripped

registers.name: Status word - Error
registers.description: 1 = error without a trip

registers.name: Status word - Trip lock
registers.description: 1 = tripped and locked

registers.name: Status word - Warning
registers.description: 1 = a warning is active

registers.name: Status word - Speed at reference
registers.description: 0 = speed differs from the reference, 1 = speed matches the reference

registers.name: Status word - Bus control
registers.description: 0 = local operation, 1 = the drive can be controlled over the bus

registers.name: Status word - Frequency within limits
registers.description: 0 = output frequency at a speed limit (4-12 or 4-14), 1 = within limits

registers.name: Status word - Running
registers.description: 0 = motor not running, 1 = in operation

registers.name: Status word - Stopped by overtemperature (auto start)
registers.description: 1 = stopped for temporary overtemperature, resumes by itself

registers.name: Status word - DC link voltage warning
registers.description: 1 = DC link voltage too low or too high

registers.name: Status word - Current limit exceeded
registers.description: 1 = the current limit is exceeded

registers.name: Status word - Timer exceeded
registers.description: 1 = a motor or drive thermal timer has passed 100%

registers.name: Main actual value
registers.description: Actual output frequency, scaled like the bus reference: 16384 (4000 hex) = 100%. Scale is 100/16384

registers.name: Control word (PCD block)
registers.description: Same control word as register 50000, first register of the PCD write block (8-42 PCD write configuration)

registers.name: Bus reference (PCD block)
registers.description: Same bus reference as register 50010 (16384 = 100%), second register of the PCD write block

registers.name: Status word (PCD block)
registers.description: Same status word as register 50200, first register of the PCD read block (8-43 PCD read configuration)

registers.name: Main actual value (PCD block)
registers.description: Same main actual value as register 50210 (16384 = 100%), second register of the PCD read block

registers.name: 16-01 Reference [Unit]
registers.description: Present reference in the unit set by 1-00 Configuration Mode (Hz, Nm or RPM)

registers.name: 16-15 Frequency [%]
registers.comment: The Programming Guide gives the conversion index but the data type is cut off in the page layout; int16 assumed from the range -100 to 100

registers.name: 16-18 Motor Thermal
registers.description: One-byte parameter, read as a register

registers.name: 16-35 Inverter Thermal
registers.description: One-byte parameter, read as a register

registers.name: 16-60 Digital Input
registers.description: Bit pattern of the digital inputs

registers.name: 16-62 Analog Input 53
registers.description: Voltage or current, depending on the switch setting of terminal 53

registers.name: 16-64 Analog Input 54
registers.description: Voltage or current, depending on the switch setting of terminal 54

registers.name: 16-71 Relay Output [bin]
registers.description: Bit pattern of the relay outputs

registers.name: 16-90 Alarm Word
registers.description: Alarm word as a bit pattern (bits are in the Programming Guide)

registers.name: 16-92 Warning Word
registers.description: Warning word as a bit pattern (bits are in the Programming Guide)

registers.name: 15-30 Fault Log: Error Code
registers.description: Array of 10 entries; set the index in register 9 first

registers.name: 15-51 Frequency Converter Serial Number
registers.description: 10 characters

registers.name: 3-10 Preset Reference
registers.description: Array of 8 values; set the index in register 9 first

registers.name: 8-10 Control Word Profile
registers.description: One-byte parameter, written as a register. The FC profile is the one the control and status word bits in this map follow

registers.name: 8-30 Protocol
registers.description: Takes effect after the drive is powered off and on
